translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Abraham ya' chunu tenanu malu' miitu, Négueb tusha miimi. Tsejtu junu Cadés pebulu bain, Sur pebulu bain chunu kejtaa tenatala chudimi. Tsejtu bene, junu vee mujtu chu' jamu chachi juu Guerar pebulubi chutu,
ya' shinbu Saranu ya' tsujkive tiitimi. Tsenñu Guerar pebulunu chumu rei Abimélec, Saranu taadei, ti' mandanguemi ya' shinbu tirenu.
Tsenñuren juntsa kepe Abimélecnu Dios kipibi tsandimi: Unbee miya shinbunun manga' mitya, ñu peyanun jutyunave, timi.
Tsenñuren, juntsa rei kayu juntsa shinbuba tsuindyu' mitya tsandimi: Bale Ruku, ¿ñu inu, in chachillaba tu'nu pensaa, lala tiba firu' kindetyuba?

Abrahamren inu juntsa shinbu ya' tsujkive tingayu, tsenmala ya bain uwain ya' kayaa tingayu. Tsa' mitya iya naa tsangue' supu manganu ke' bain, tiba firu' pensajtu tsangue' mitya tiba urajtuuya kendyuyu, timi.
Tsenñu kipibi Dios tsandimi: Iya miyu naa ñu tsangue' bain tiba firu' kenu pensajtu tsanguiñuba. Tsaañu' mityaa iya ñunu juntsa shinbuba tyushtenu kindyuyu, ñu inu ujcha lan jutyu.

Tsa' mitya challa juntsa rukunu ya' shinbu mangude; yaa in mitya pamu rukuve. Tsenmalaa ya ñu peyatyusa tyatu inu u'tandinu tsuve, tsaaren ñu manguwai'shu juntsaa, ñu bain, naa ñu' chachilla bain uwain peyanu detsuve, timi.
Tsejtu ayunchi Abimélec kepenene kujpatu, kumuinchi yachi tiba kiikemu chachillanu demikatu, ya ti kipi'ba dekuinda kemi. Tsenñu yala, rei tsandiñu meenatu, yuj jeetyala.

Tsejtu bene Abimélec, Abrahamnu janu mandanguetu tsandimi: ¿Tyee lalanu ketunguiyu? ¿Tyee ke' ñunu firu' dekiñaa, naa inu bain, naa in chachillanu bain tsamantsa ujcha lawaanuu ketunguiyu? Juntsaaya ki'nutsumive.
Tsenñu Abraham tsandimi: In pensaya entsa tenasha Diosnu meenguityu deeve tenñundiwayu tsandimi, tsandi'shu juntsaya in shinbu' mityan inu tu'nu dejuve tenñu.
Tsaaren ura uwaindiyu yaa in tsujkive; ya in apa' na'mave, naa in amachee ya' na'ma jutyuñuba, tsenñu i yaba buudi' chuyu.
Tsejtu Dios inu in apa' yanu lu' ji' vee mujtu jide ti' uudenguiñu, nunbatalaba nenu lu' jindu, in shinbu Saranu naaju pebulutala viji'ba iya ya' kayave, tide titu tsandiyu, timi.
Tsenñu Abimélec Abrahamnu ya' shinbu Saranu manguwatu, naa uveja juula, naa wagaa juula, naa tiba kiikemu chachilla unbee rukula bain, supula bain demekikemi.
Tsejtu tsandimi: Keekide, entsa in turen tsanave. Nunbatalaa ñuchi kayu urañuba mi'ke' ka' chude, timi.

Tsejtu Saranuya tsandimi: Ñu' kayanu 1.000 lepa lushi jeru kuwayu. Tsenmalaa kumuinchi ñuiba bulu pudenashu juntsala ñunu firu' panu deke'ba yala' firu' panu pensa manbashiinudetsu. Tsa' mitya muba ñunu firu' panu dejutyuve, timi.
Tsenñu Abraham Diosba kuinda keñu, Abimélecnu bain, naa ya' shinbunu bain Dios ura' mandiremi. Tsenmin yachi manda-imu shinbulanu bain de-ura' mandiremi nakanudetsu,
matyu Sara' mityaren, Yavé tsaa Abimélec' yanu chumu shinbulanuya maliba navinu jutyungue shuikeñu' mitya.
